mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in last 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in last 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side expansion, measured by rising industrial production, the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to improved corporate capacity utilization and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances during supply-side expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is growing.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and decline in unemployment signals a strong labor market supporting housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in last 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in last 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, indicated by rising federal funds rates, the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles.
